notes.title: Game Announcement - Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate
notes.content:
[h1]DEMO AVAILABLE NOW![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3281870/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate_Demo/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38528668/7362ade645c19a49bb02640e8115533bb18702dd.png[/img]

[h1]Secret Agendas. . .[/h1]
Secret Agent Wizard Boy was a normal Wizard Boy on his way to his first year at Wizard School until he received a message from MI6.

"Wizard Boy," it said. "We've received intel that the headmaster of Wizard School, Grumblemort, is the leader of a criminal organization named S.P.I.D.E.R. We need you to investigate!"

And so Wizard Boy started his first year at Wizard School, trying to uncover the mysteries that lay before him.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38528668/6193717666145158acbcf0e3c93d36c23f2c98a4.png[/img]

Secret Agent Wizard Boy is a sandbox wizard sim that can be played alone or in cooperative(?) multiplayer. Explore (blow up) the castle, find secrets, solve puzzles, and discover the mystery hidden deep in the castle.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] A multitude of spells to learn and inflict on others
[*] Physics-based mayhem
[*] Open-ended goals to accomplish (or ignore) however you see fit
[*] Online multiplayer
[*] Retro-themed third person action, straight from the days of Unreal Engine 1
[*] Landmines
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38528668/1a706856e6cb9c0173ac8127a325c213ec8f0a37.png[/img]

. . . And the demo is available to play right now! Go take a look!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3281870/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate_Demo/

[h1]Hey, Ducky![/h1]

It's been a little while. You may or may not know that I've been working on a lot of games since we had our adventure together. In fact, I think more people know who you are from my social profiles than from your own game! Pretty cool how that works, isn't it?

notes.title: My Next Game: My Friendly Neighborhood
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11106370/bab1f1a4cc6249ff033db74ae6ed411b017e5892.png[/img]
[h1]Survival Horror, but with Puppets[/h1]
Hey guys! I am super happy to report that I finally have a[b] brand new project[/b] to share. Ever wonder what your favorite children's TV shows would look like with a dash of survival horror? MFN is the [b]marriage of survival horror and puppets[/b], giving you an [b]open world to fight through[/b] and explore, [b]big mysteries[/b] to solve,[b] puzzles out the whazoo[/b], and a ton more.

So what sort of things should you expect to find in My Friendly Neighborhood?

[list]
[*]Non-linear, first person survival horror gameplay
[*]A colorful cast of puppet friends turned adversaries (and maybe turned friends again!)
[*]An array of puzzles in the vein of the survival horror greats.
[*]A multitude of diverse environments, from the "BTS" Ray's Workshop to cardboard crayon halls
[*]A grid-based real-time inventory, cause that's just way better
[*]And a lot more. . . but I'll let you find that out for yourself
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11106370/8bbdc83d1a86f9f9920be5dd81ea064ca62d012d.gif[/img]

Also, just a note - it might be a horror game, but expect the same sort of [b]playful, humorous take on things[/b] that you might have found in my other games. It's spooky, but I think you'll find a lot of smiles along the way. :)

I'm really happy to report that this is by far the biggest project I've ever worked on. I have a TON of great stuff planned that I can't wait for you all to experience. . . but I'll let you find all of that for yourselves.

[h1]Could You do me a Favor?[/h1]
If you're interested, could you [b]drop a wishlist on the Steam page?[/b] That's by far the best way to support the game, and by extension me too! :) Thanks for reading! Hope to see you. . . [b]IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574260/My_Friendly_Neighborhood/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11106370/55a978439e935c8095e0cfe6d13dcf10c063cc4f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Post-Game Content Update
notes.content:
HELLO, DUCKS.

It's been quite a while since I've done much with Rubber Ducky, here. If you follow my Twitter or Twitch, you'll know that I've been working on a new entry in the Rubber Ducky series in my free time. That game is a while away to say the least - but, in the meantime, I've decided I'd like to do a few updates to the old Rubber Ducky as-is.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11106370/7f4d40560ebfaab831f45140dc710d7fcd92ee6f.png[/img] 
[i](Image from the new Rubber Ducky, in progress)[/i]

For this update, I've added in a little bit of content in the post-game, including a secret boss fight (with a familiar face) and a mysterious message that's going to take a lot of different users working together to uncover.  Also, I've done some work on the code to optimize the game, meaning there should be quite a bit less frame drops in certain parts and less crashes.  I am going to be working on porting Rubber Ducky to new platforms soon, so keep an eye out for that.

Depending on schedule and reactions, I have some other ideas of things to do to further update Rubber Ducky. Drop me a line at any of the links below and let me know what you think!

If you'd like to keep posted, consider following my Twitter, Twitch, or joining the Rubber Ducky Discord: 

[url=https://twitter.com/Cr2CrStudios]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/ducky_dev]Twitch[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/TPNFGCd]Discord[/url]

notes.title: An Open Letter to Goat Simulator
notes.content:
I, as developer and proctor of Rubber Ducky and the Rainbow Gun and supporter of all duck-related activity on Steam, hereby do proclaim that, recognizing the superiority of ducks over goats, we shall fight tooth and nail for possession of the coveted "Best Use of a Farm Animal" award.  We believe this award belongs to a game that properly represents the greater of the two species of farm animals.  We are a small community, yes, but we hold to the hope that you, our enemy, will see the reason behind our cause (since ducks are better than goats) and will join us for the mutual elevation of ducks during these "Best Use of a Farm Animal" election primaries.

We realize that words are just words.  To help you understand our cause, we have compiled a list of the most important reasons why ducks are better than goats.  Namely:

1. Because they are
2. QUACK > BAAAAAH
3. Ducks have feathers!
4. Goats don't have feathers.
5. Oh wait, do goats sometimes have feathers?

Let this become our resounding argument to the masses.  We confidently leave to your own will the judgement of if our cause is righteous.

Also, Goat Sim is awesome.  Plzkeepdoingwhatyou'redoing.

notes.title: How to Fix the Won't Start Bug - Steam Beta Issues
notes.content:
EDIT: I seem to have finally been able to fix the issue for good.  Let me know if you're still having issues with the game starting.  :)

Hey guys - I've finally gotten a way to reproduce the "won't start" issue with the new update.  For some reason, the beta version of Steam and Rubber Ducky don't get along, so if you go to Settings -> Steam Beta Settings -> Opt out of Beta and restart Steam so you're not using the Steam beta, the game will run again!

I'll contact Steam and see if they can fix the issue on their end.

notes.title: New update seems to have issues with antivirus. . .
notes.content:
Hey guys!  The new Rubber Ducky updates seems to be having issues with antivirus software, particularly Avast.  If the game doesn't launch after you click play, then do this:

1) Restart your computer
2) Turn off and file shield or real-time protection for your anti-virus
3) Run the game as an administrator

I'll try to figure out why these programs are having issues and release a small patch to fix it.  Thanks!

EDIT: For now, if the game isn't working for anyone that it was, I added a launch option to use the past version instead - it won't play the DLC, but it still has almost all of the other content!
